convert_image_bytes_to_numpy: convert PNG bytes data into a numpy array with optional resize using img_from_bytes
convert_numpy_to_bytes: convert a numpy array image to PNG bytes using img_to_bytes
convert_pil_to_bytes: convert a PIL Image object to bytes using pil_to_bytes
convert_torch_to_bytes: convert a channels-first torch image array to bytes using torch_to_bytes
export_h5_to_gif: export PNG images stored in an HDF5 group to an animated GIF file using png_to_gif
